_comment: Per-document original descriptions (written by reading each document's actual content). Keyed by Drive file id. Used by the site UI (TeacherShared DocCard) and search index (resourceAggregator). Kept in a SEPARATE file so the nightly Drive sync (which rebuilds teacher-contents*.json) never overwrites it.
